extraction_notes: Only SI catalyst-performance tables were extracted. SI Figure S1 is a stability test, but no readable plotted data were provided in the supplied SI text/images beyond its caption, so no time-on-stream records were extracted. SI Table S2/S3 and Figures S2–S5 are characterisation/thermal data and were excluded. Feed composition, H2/CO2 ratio, catalyst mass and total flow are not reported in the supplied SI text.
